When `len(p.states) >= termHeight`, `p.pos` is set to `len(p.states)` instead of the number of lines actually printed. On subsequent `render()` calls, `for range p.pos - 1 { fmt.Fprint(p.w, "\033[A") }` moves the cursor up by more lines than were printed. Additionally, inside the loop, the newline condition `i < len(p.states)-1` will emit a newline after every printed line up to `termHeight-1`, printing an extra trailing newline and causing the terminal to scroll off-screen.
